course.title: Housing and Real Estate Development Theory
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: Identify the possible investment risks. Explain the four combinations of real (15) estate investment risk with examples.

Your company will purchase a parcel of land in next month for BDT 1300 (10) million. For how much will your company have to sell the property in 30 years to earn a 10% annual return on both initial outlay and expected annual payment of BDT 75 million for property tax and development to the land? Assume these finds could be invested at comparable risk to earn a 10% annual return.
